notice: Features, artwork, and availability may change as the game is built. This guide includes the current creature roster and regions still in development.

creatures.name: Albatrossaurus
creatures.description: Slate-blue feathers and a cream crest frame Albatrossaurus's amber eyes and hooked golden bill. It strides between fern beds, then spreads its broad wings to glide along the island cliffs.

creatures.name: Alpanda
creatures.description: Cloud-soft cream fleece, rounded dark ears and gentle eye markings give Alpanda a calm, thoughtful look. Its long neck rises above a dark shoulder band, while sturdy black legs and a little fluffy tail complete its soft silhouette.

creatures.name: Armadillope
creatures.description: A nimble grazer wrapped in rounded bands of protective armour. Armadillope bounds across dry grass on slender legs, then folds itself into a compact shelter beneath a shady rock.

creatures.name: Badgermunk
creatures.description: A bright-eyed woodland burrower with a cream stripe, soft round ears and a broad banded tail. Badgermunk stashes seeds in tidy piles, then does a delighted little bounce when it finds one it forgot.

creatures.name: Banaconda
creatures.description: A long, curved burrower with golden skin, tiny brown freckles and a smooth cream belly. Banaconda settles into warm loops beneath broad leaves and takes great care choosing its favourite patch of shade.

creatures.name: Batacuda
creatures.description: A sleek blue swimmer with broad velvety wings and soft pointed ears. Batacuda follows ripples at dusk, sweeping low enough for its tail to brush the surface.

creatures.name: Bearbecue
creatures.description: A broad-backed creature with a mantle of glowing feathers and a warm fan tail. Bearbecue pads along the rocky slopes, then folds its paws and lifts into the mountain air.

creatures.name: Botterfly
creatures.description: Orange and turquoise patterns flow across Botterfly's soft coat, broad wings and long swimming tail. Its whiskered face stays alert as it paddles through quiet water or opens its wings above the reeds.

creatures.name: Bunblebee
creatures.description: A tiny, round pollinator with soft striped fluff, long listening ears and buzzing wings. Bunblebee drifts between flowers, gathering sweetness before curling up in a sheltered blossom.

creatures.name: Chinchillark
creatures.description: A bright-eyed cliff dweller with rosy ears, soft gray fur and pale blue flight feathers. Chinchillark flutters between high ledges and lands with a quick shuffle of its golden talons.

creatures.name: Clownurchin
creatures.description: A bright orange swimmer with bold white bands, violet-tipped spines and broad fan-shaped fins. Clownurchin drifts between reef ledges, steering with tiny fin flicks before darting into a favourite sheltered nook.

creatures.name: Cluckitty
creatures.description: A plump featherball with pointed ears, bright eyes and a tiny beak. Cluckitty purrs in warm nesting places, then springs up to chase any leaf that tumbles past.

creatures.name: Cockapoodle
creatures.description: A lively curly-coated companion with soft hanging ears, a sunny crest and feathered wings. Cockapoodle bounds along on four gentle paws, lifting its feathered tail whenever something catches its attention.

creatures.name: Crabuki
creatures.description: A round, masked shore-dweller with a sturdy shell, eight quick legs and two broad pincers. Crabuki shuffles sideways when excited, leaving dotted tracks across the wet sand.

creatures.name: Crocodoodle Doo
creatures.description: A low, green prowler with a broad snout, tiny rounded teeth and a bright red crest. Crocodoodle Doo carries a proud fan of tail feathers and greets the morning with a call that ends in a bubbly little snap.

creatures.name: Dandylion
creatures.description: A golden wanderer with soft padded paws and a bright mane of yellow petals. Dandylion's warm coat ends in one fluffy white seed head at the tip of its tail, which bobs gently with every step.

creatures.name: Donkeyote
creatures.description: With tall ears, a golden mane and a bushy tail, Donkeyote trots along Clover Farm's fence lines and pauses to listen for the rustle of seed pods.

creatures.name: Dragorilla
creatures.description: A broad-shouldered giant with powerful hands, emerald scales and folded membrane wings. Dragorilla can look imposing until it carefully cups a tiny flower between its enormous palms.

creatures.name: Fennthorn
creatures.description: Fennthorn pauses on the dunes with its oversized ears raised and its blue-tipped tail held low.

creatures.name: Flamingoat
creatures.description: Pink feathers cover Flamingoat's slender body, rising along a graceful neck to a bright face with tiny curved horns. It steps through shallow water on dainty dark hooves, carefully testing each stone before moving on.

creatures.name: Froggle
creatures.description: An emerald glider with a little hooked beak, feathered wings and powerful folded hind legs. Froggle watches the water from high branches before springing into the air and gliding down among floating leaves.

creatures.name: Geckostrich
creatures.description: Geckostrich crosses the dunes on long legs. Its small wings flare when it picks up speed.

creatures.name: Giraffish
creatures.description: A golden swimmer with a long spotted neck, small rounded head crests and flowing amber fins. Giraffish threads its neck through the reeds, steering its scaled body with a gentle sweep of its forked tail.

creatures.name: Glidigan
creatures.description: Glidigan bounds across snowy ledges and stretches its feathered membranes to glide from cliff to cliff.

creatures.name: Goosemoose
creatures.description: A long-necked lake bird with broad wings and a pair of branching antlers. Goosemoose paddles between reed beds and lifts off across open water.

creatures.name: Hamsturtle
creatures.description: A round little forager with full cheeks, tiny paws and a sturdy shell. Hamsturtle carries its favourite hiding place everywhere, stopping often to tuck away another mouthful of food.

creatures.name: Harpyeena
creatures.description: Rounded ears and broad feathered wings give Harpyeena its familiar outline. It pads along cliff paths and takes flight where the rock falls away.

creatures.name: Hootopotamus
creatures.description: A round, downy water-dweller with bright amber eyes, a broad muzzle and soft feathered wings. Hootopotamus dozes beside cool pools by day, waking at dusk to listen for familiar calls.

creatures.name: Humminglow
creatures.description: Humminglow hovers among jungle flowers. At dusk its golden lantern shines between the leaves.

creatures.name: Iguanarwhal
creatures.description: Iguanarwhal glides through the abyss with a long tusk, four fins and a broad tail fluke.

creatures.name: Jellyphant
creatures.description: A translucent lavender drifter with a softly glowing dome, trailing frills and a long curling trunk. Jellyphant moves with a gentle sway, reaching out curiously as it passes through the water.

creatures.name: Jerboar
creatures.description: Jerboar lifts its tall ears above the sand while its compact hooves pick a quick path between the rocks.

creatures.name: Kiwink
creatures.description: Kiwink picks through leaf litter with its long bill. Its round body and scaled tail slip between roots and low branches.

creatures.name: Koalameleon
creatures.description: A soft-eared climber with a broad dark nose, gentle eyes and a tightly curled tail. Koalameleon's coat shifts through shades of green as its mood changes, helping it settle quietly among the leaves.

creatures.name: Labraduck
creatures.description: A golden-feathered guardian with soft hanging ears, bright eyes and a broad amber bill. Labraduck counts every egg before settling beside the water, keeping a watchful eye on its home.

creatures.name: Ladymole
creatures.description: Ladymole noses through the woodland leaf litter with wide pink paws, a scarlet spotted shell and two curious antennae.

creatures.name: Lobsteray
creatures.description: Lobsteray flaps its broad fins just above the sand and feels between reef rocks with its antennae.

creatures.name: Manapill
creatures.description: Manapill paddles along the lake bed, with a round blue shell and two pale-tipped flippers.

creatures.name: Meerkabou
creatures.description: A watchful little sentinel with velvety antlers and a thick, fluffy collar. Meerkabou rises onto its sturdy back feet to announce every visitor, sometimes sounding the alarm for a falling leaf.

creatures.name: Mooroo
creatures.description: A spotted hopper with tall ears, small ivory horns and a broad pink muzzle. Mooroo holds its short hoofed forelimbs above a roomy pouch, using powerful hind legs and a thick tufted tail to bound between grassy clearings.

creatures.name: Pangolinx
creatures.description: Pangolinx pads along the jungle floor with tufted ears, a plated back and a long armoured tail.

creatures.name: Peacobara
creatures.description: Shimmering teal, emerald and blue feathers cover Peacobara's rounded body and gentle face. It moves with quiet composure, its splendid tail fan patterned with golden eyespots.

creatures.name: Pelicanary
creatures.description: A bright yellow flier with a long curved bill, a roomy throat pouch and tiny webbed feet. Pelicanary carries smooth pebbles to its nest, pausing between trips to sing from a favourite perch.

creatures.name: Platypuffin
creatures.description: Warm brown feathers, cream cheek patches and a broad orange bill give Platypuffin a cheerful face. It waddles along quiet shores, paddles through the reeds and takes short, busy flights over the lake. Its wide flat tail leaves little ripples wherever it goes.

creatures.name: Porcupython
creatures.description: Soft-tipped quills cover Porcupython's long, flexible back, leaving its belly smooth. It watches the world with a patient gaze before winding into a cosy coil with its delicate underside tucked safely away.

creatures.name: Puffalo
creatures.description: A sturdy, round grazer with small curved horns, tiny fins and soft, blunt spines. When startled, Puffalo inflates its belly into a great wobbling ball, looking more surprised than anyone around it.

creatures.name: Puglet
creatures.description: A plump little companion with expressive brown eyes, a wrinkled dark muzzle and a soft pink snout. Puglet shuffles on tiny hooves and curls its tail tightly before settling into the warmest patch of straw.

creatures.name: Purranha
creatures.description: Silver-blue scales and dark flowing stripes cover Purranha's rounded body. Bright blue eyes, pink ear fins and a tiny triangular-toothed grin give it a playful look, while fine whiskers frame a shallow cream muzzle that blends smoothly into its gilled sides.

creatures.name: Quokkaflash
creatures.description: Quokkaflash bounds through the reeds and takes off on four rainbow-veined wings.

creatures.name: Scorpicorn
creatures.description: Pearly armour, a flowing lavender mane and a golden spiral horn give Scorpicorn a luminous silhouette. Six small legs carry it forward, with rounded pincers at the front and a curling gold-tipped tail above its back.

creatures.name: Shrimpanzee
creatures.description: Shrimpanzee props itself on broad knuckles on dry ground and sweeps its arms and tail fan to swim.

creatures.name: Slothtopus
creatures.description: A gentle deepwater dweller with warm brown fur, a cream face and eight curling arms lined with rounded suckers. Slothtopus drifts through quiet currents, slowly gathering its arms before easing into another unhurried swim.

creatures.name: Tarantulama
creatures.description: Cream wool surrounds Tarantulama's long neck, upright ears and gentle face. Eight soft, careful legs carry its rounded body over uneven ground, lifting clear of its own tumbling curls.

creatures.name: Tricerahops
creatures.description: A sturdy mint-green island dweller with teal spots, three orange horns and a broad cream-edged frill. Tricerahops browses fern beds at an easy walk, then springs into low bounds when something catches its eye.

creatures.name: Vulturkey
creatures.description: Vulturkey fans its tail on the dunes, then spreads broad wings to cross the gullies.

creatures.name: Woolrus
creatures.description: Thick cream curls surround Woolrus's round body, broad muzzle and two small ivory tusks. Its soft whiskers twitch above sturdy split hooves as it searches for tender shoots.

creatures.name: Wriggsalotl
creatures.description: A cheerful little burrower with a long, flexible body and fluttering frilled gills. Wriggsalotl slips through damp soil and wriggles with delight whenever it finds a fresh puddle.

regions.name: Home
regions.description: The safe return point for eggs you bring home, with space for your garden and creature collection. Start your next egg run here and return with what you find.

regions.name: Sunnyside Backyard
regions.description: The first region beyond Home, with grassy ground and a watchful Labraduck guarding its eggs. Its small burrowers, pollinators, and feathered companions introduce the creature collection.

regions.name: Clover Farm
regions.description: Open fields and fence lines make up Clover Farm. Mooroo watches over the eggs, while creatures such as Donkeyote, Alpanda, Puglet, and Woolrus belong to this region.

regions.name: Ripplewater Lake
regions.description: Shorelines, reeds, and open water are home to a wide variety of swimming and flying creatures. Hamsturtle guards the lake eggs.

regions.name: Acorn Woods
regions.description: A wooded region beyond the lake, filled with trees, leaf litter, and roots. Porcupython guards its eggs, while Kiwink and Badgermunk search the forest floor.

regions.name: Jungle Wilds
regions.description: Dense green growth marks the last region on the main route before the world branches toward water, mountain, and sky regions. Dandylion guards the jungle eggs.

regions.name: Rainbow Coral Reef
regions.description: The first region on the water route, with underwater ground and reef creatures such as Clownurchin, Giraffish, and Lobsteray. Crabuki guards the eggs here.

regions.name: Deepwater Abyss
regions.description: Deeper water beyond Rainbow Coral Reef is home to Batacuda, Jellyphant, Slothtopus, and other unusual swimmers. Batacuda guards the abyss eggs.

regions.name: Lost World
regions.description: An island beyond Deepwater Abyss, with beaches, fern beds, and tall prehistoric greenery. Tricerahops guards its eggs, and Albatrossaurus glides along the island cliffs.

regions.name: Golden Dunes
regions.description: A dry region of sand and rock on the mountain route. Armadillope guards the eggs, while long-legged runners, watchful sentinels, and winged creatures cross the dunes.

regions.name: Ember Mountain
regions.description: Rocky slopes rise beyond Golden Dunes. Dragorilla guards the mountain eggs, and the glowing feathers of Bearbecue belong to this region.

regions.name: The Burning Depths
regions.description: A future region beyond Ember Mountain on the mountain route. Its creatures and final design are still being developed.

regions.name: Cloudstone Caverns
regions.description: The first region on the sky route, reached from Jungle Wilds. Froggle guards its eggs, while Harpyeena moves between cliff paths and open air.

regions.name: Cloudtop Cliffs
regions.description: A high region beyond Cloudstone Caverns, with snowy ledges and open cliff faces. Chinchillark and Glidigan are part of its developing creature roster.

regions.name: Moonbeam Expanse
regions.description: A future region above Cloudtop Cliffs, planned as the farthest part of the sky route. Its creatures and final design are still being developed.

guides.title: Getting started
guides.summary: The basic egg run and creature collection loop.

sections.title: Start from Home
paragraphs: Home is the safe return point for an egg run. Head into the surrounding regions to find wild eggs and the guardians that protect them.
The game is still under development. Access may be limited while Orchard Studios builds and tests it. No release date has been announced.

sections.title: Take an egg and get back
paragraphs: Use the interaction shown on a wild egg and hold it until the pickup completes. Releasing early cancels the pickup. You carry one wild egg at a time.
Taking an egg starts a guardian chase. Return to Home with it to secure it in your inventory. Heavier eggs can make the return journey slower, so leave yourself room to get back.

sections.title: Build your collection
paragraphs: Once an egg is yours, it can be placed in your own purchased garden area to incubate. Use Hatch when it is ready to discover the creature inside.
Pets and eggs have separate management screens. Follow the current prompts in game for controls and available actions.

guides.title: Eggs and hatching
guides.summary: From a stolen egg to a creature of your own.

sections.title: Egg traits
paragraphs: Eggs have a species, quality, size, and weight. Quality and species are separate traits. An egg's weight affects how difficult it is to carry.
Standard, Fine, Superior, Epic, and Legendary are quality levels. They are separate from the creature's conservation status and the region where it lives.

sections.title: Incubation in the garden
paragraphs: Place an owned inventory egg in your own purchased garden space. It stays there while it incubates and becomes ready to hatch. Becoming ready does not hatch it automatically.
The egg's countdown and available actions show its current state. Incubation requirements can change as development and balancing continue.

sections.title: Hatching and discovery
paragraphs: Use the egg's Hatch action when it is ready. A successful hatch adds a creature and shows its Birth Certificate with the individual pet's details.
If there is no suitable Garden space, the game may offer a choice or keep the new creature in Stored pets. Read the confirmation before selecting which pet to keep in the Garden.

guides.title: Pets and gardens
guides.summary: Manage your creatures at Home and choose a companion.

sections.title: Garden, Stored, and Collection
paragraphs: Garden pets live on your purchased land. Stored pets remain in your collection without taking a Garden place. The species Collection records what you have discovered.
Garden pets can wander, nap, and be petted. An owned pet keeps its own identity and individual details when you move it between available assignments.

sections.title: Choose a companion
paragraphs: Use Follow on an eligible owned pet to take it with you. Following and riding share one active companion slot, so choosing another companion replaces the previous selection.
Some species can be ridden. Other following species have a particular buff. The current pet information explains which benefit applies.

sections.title: Feeding and petting
paragraphs: Pets have different diets. Offer Fish to a pet that eats meat or Banana to one that eats plants. A pet that eats both can take either.
Use the pet's available Feed or Praise action. Feeding and petting can give temporary benefits; the in-game information shows the current effect.
